recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured composition featuring a large, central black numeral set against a subtle, dark grey-on-black tartan plaid background. A secondary line of text sits above the numeral in a contrasting light grey, textured sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central numeral as the primary focal point
Subtle tonal contrast between black foreground and dark plaid background
Textured secondary text providing a horizontal counterweight to the verticality of the numeral
Diagonal grid of the plaid pattern creating a rhythmic texture behind smooth shapes
coreInvariants: High-contrast secondary text with inner texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large numeral dominates the center, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy base of the central numeral.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the light-colored top text, moves down to the large central numeral, and follows the curves of the glyph.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the dark plaid pattern, creating a moody, atmospheric feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and primary numeral)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation; value contrast is the primary driver of visibility.

letterConstructionRules: Primary numeral uses high-contrast strokes with sharp, flared terminals
Secondary text uses a blocky, wide sans-serif with distressed internal texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeral '3' features a sharp, horizontal top bar and a deep, rounded bottom bowl
Numeral '1' is a thick vertical slab with a slight curve on the left side
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif numeral paired with a wide, industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle outer glow on dark elements to separate from background

avoid: Busy backgrounds without a grid structure

candidateDirections.reason: For the secondary text due to its wide stance and small serifs that mimic the blocky feel.
For the numeral skeleton, providing the high contrast and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, monochromatic charcoal and black tartan plaid pattern with a fine fabric texture. Ensure the lighting is flat and moody.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, solid black serif numeral '31' in the center with a very subtle outer glow. Above it, add the text 'GLASS TIGER' in a wide, uppercase, light-grey sans-serif with a distressed metallic texture.

verificationChecks: Is the plaid pattern subtle enough to not distract from the text?
Is the contrast between the black numeral and black background maintained via texture or glow?
Is the secondary text clearly legible against the dark background?

adjustableVariables: Overall brightness of the grey tones
mustRedesign: Exact tartan weave pattern if trademarked
postGenerationChecks: Check for moiré patterns in the plaid
Verify the distressed texture on the top text is visible but not messy
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark Tartan Background + Large High-Contrast Serif Numeral + Textured Wide Sans-Serif Header = Moody Anniversary Aesthetic
